name: Easy Korean Tofu Stew (Yukgaejang) with Bok Choy, Carrots & Radishes
ingredients: 64 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Halve chili peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and place in a large bowl. (Be careful, with chilis, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl along with oil, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and salt. Whisk to combine the pepper paste. Transfer half to a large pot and set aside.
Large dice tofu and add to the bowl with the remaining pepper paste. Toss to combine and set aside.
Trim off and discard root ends of the bok choy; separate into leaves and add to the pot.
Trim and cut onions into 1-inch pieces; add to the pot.
Peel and roughly chop carrots; add to the pot.
Trim and quarter radishes; add to the pot along with the edamame.
Add broth to the pot, stir to combine, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Once boiling, add tofu and sauce. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and tofu is heated through, about 3 minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with sesame seeds and a drizzle of oil. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
